title: Law 1 Probe v2: Full-32D Intra-Mode Covariance Rank (P=512)
intuition: Split out from v1's compound R^32 probe to isolate Law 1 full-32D covariance rank: requires core_eig_min >= 0.25 across all 5 Haar-rotated R^32 clusters with P=512 particles (>32 particles even on the 8% minority mode).
failure_mode: Low-rank projection sketches, Jensen covariance shrinkage, or particle under-allocation collapse intra-cluster covariance eigenvalues in R^32 even when cluster centers are found.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence v2 diagnostic probe (1,400 updates, Haar-rotated R^32, P=512).
